duplicate_and_multi_return.limitation: released first-return slots cannot reveal discarded echo order

provenance.frame_selection: fixed uniform full-span sample every 28 frames
provenance.limitation: RayGrid.audit retains detailed per-return intermediates; full 449-frame round-trip is reported separately

definitions.Nvis: median visible returns over frames in which the entity is visible
definitions.O: one minus total visible returns divided by accepted returns before occlusion
definitions.V: number of the five frames with at least one visible return
definitions.d: median sensor range of visible inserted returns in metres

provenance.feature_sampling: all eligible controls up to a deterministic 1024-slot uniform cap per visible frame
provenance.group_split: deterministic frame-group 80/20 split with disjoint frames
provenance.matching_rule: one-to-one unique nearest real-normal xyz return within each frame
